en.headline: Tsim Sha Tsui lanterns stay lit through the Mid-Autumn holiday
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s display at the Cultural Centre Piazza runs nightly until 11 October, with a weekend creative market on Saturday and Sunday.
body: Lanterns at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza in Tsim Sha Tsui remain switched on through the Mid-Autumn public holiday, as the Leisure and Cultural Services Department continues its citywide carnival.

The department said the Tsim Sha Tsui display, titled Moonlit Bunny Crew, was created by local studio Stickyline and shows Hong Kong landmarks in a geometric lantern style. Lights run from 6.30pm to 11pm. The installation opened on 6 September and is scheduled to stay until 11 October.

A Mid-Autumn creative market is also being held at the site on Saturdays and Sundays during the carnival period, including this holiday weekend. Admission to the outdoor display is free. The department is running a separate lantern programme at Victoria Park.

zh.headline: 尖沙嘴文化中心中秋綵燈假期繼續亮燈
zh.dek: 康文署文化中心露天廣場綵燈展每晚6時30分至11時開放，展期至10月11日，本周末另設中秋創意市集。
body: 中秋節翌日公眾假期，尖沙嘴香港文化中心露天廣場的綵燈繼續亮燈，屬康樂及文化事務署全港中秋綵燈會一部分。
康文署表示，尖沙嘴展區主題為「月光兔仔團」，由本地創作單位Stickyline以幾何綵燈呈現香港地標，亮燈時間為每晚6時30分至11時。展覽由9月6日開始，預定至10月11日。
綵燈會期間周六及周日設中秋創意市集，包括本個假期周末。戶外展覽免費入場。康文署另於維多利亞公園設綵燈節目。
